paper_title: Measuring the stability of fundamental constants with a network of clocks
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda_gamma in GeV^-1 (linear-in-phi scalar-photon coupling; NOT converted to dimensionless d_e)
notes: QSNET clock-network projection paper. Fig. 6a shows projected sensitivity to a linear scalar dark-matter coupling to the electromagnetic field (drives variation of alpha => ScalarPhoton), while Fig. 6b is the electron-mass coupling (ScalarElectron) and Fig. 7 gives the quadratic-coupling cases. This is a forecast/sensitivity projection, not a measured exclusion. The plotted y-axis is the effective new-physics scale Lambda_gamma; I could not reliably read exact numerical values off the figure, so the emitted data points are rough estimates of 1/Lambda_gamma in GeV^-1 spanning the ~1e-24 to 1e-13 eV mass range. To obtain the canonical dimensionless d_e one would use d_e = (1/Lambda_gamma)/kappa with kappa = sqrt(4*pi*G_N) ~ 2.9e-19 GeV^-1 (not applied here). Values are approximate; treat with caution. | selector: text (sole candidate)
